name: BoT and RISCO reports, Q4 FY26 to Q2 FY27

notes.FY26Q4: EBITDA has decreased in Q4 mainly due to bad debts provision relating to Zimswitch and Banking Services recoveries that were written off by the business. Revenue growth was driven mainly by the Send Money and CashOut use cases (contributed 47% to total revenue). Mastercard costs were also on the increase as this revenue line increased in adoption.
notes.FY27Q1: EBITDA margin was primarily driven by increased wallet funding, which averaged US$370 million per month and culminated in a total of US$3.1 billion for the year (up from US$1.67 billion in FY25). Q1 closed with revenue at 9% above budget as the business continue to gain momentum due to Marketing and Sales intiatives to improve revenue and business growth.
notes.FY27Q2: Q2 closed with EBITDA margin at 33%, 2 points below target as marketing rose to 8.4% for ChakaChaya and the Super App launch. Revenue finished 14% above budget, gross margin improved to 65%, ROE was 27% and ROA 6%.

notes.FY26Q4: Ecocash also took part in the iJoy after Joy Promotion launched from MNO and Partner Promo with Pick n Pay in Q4 There continues to be considerable growth on the number of active 30 and 90 customers for both ZwG and USD customers. The business added One more product, Payment reminders two more remittance partners to the EcoCash platform, Tranglo and Impact Remit.
notes.FY27Q1: There was growth in active 30 and active 90 customers. The business has continued to grow the number of DMT partners to enhance the customer convenience. 2 remittance partners were added to the EcoCash platform, Zimoney -Australia and Tookiyo Trading -South Africa.
notes.FY27Q2: Q2 customer activity strengthened during the ChakaChaya Promotion: Active 30 reached 4.68m, Active 90 reached 5.49m and Active 30 USD reached 4.60m. Active DMT partners increased from 14,355 in Q1 to 16,112 in Q2, driven by deliberate distribution expansion initiatives and increased partner activation. Growth was primarily supported by EcoCash franchises, which rose from 14,913 to 18,862, while Business Agents increased from 771 to 839. Econet shops and franchises remained stable at 58 and 172 respectively. International remittance partners remained at 2, including Zimoney and Tookiyo Trading.

notes.FY26Q4: Office expenses margin decreased to 4.7% due to continuous implementation of cost optimization strategies by the business. Marketing expenses maintained at 4% in response to cost containment initiatives implemented by the business.
notes.FY27Q1: Staff costs margin closed at 5.6%. Marketing expenses increased to 4.7% mainly due to Chakachaya promotion related costs . The overheads margin decreased due to cost optimization initiatives implemented by management in Q1
notes.FY27Q2: Q2 office expense was 4.7%, staff cost 5.5% and the expense ratio 31%. Marketing expense rose to 8.4% due to ChakaChaya and the Super App launch; Borrowdale renovations continued.

notes.FY26Q4: US$ revenue contribution remained to 94% due to business initiatives to grow the US$ business despite rapid growth of the ZWG revenue. Monetary assets growth remained at 72% due to balanced growth in customer transactions.
notes.FY27Q1: USD Revenue contribution decreased to 91% due to increased growth in ZWG revenue Monetary assets growth increased to 74% due to balanced growth in customer transactions.
notes.FY27Q2: USD revenue returned to the 93% target. Monetary assets increased to 91% with higher transaction volumes, while FX loss reduced to 4% of EBITDA and 1% of revenue. • USD MoM inflation rose to 0.28% in July; food was 0.22% and non-food 0.31%. • ZWG eased to 0.10% as USD accelerated to 0.30%, reversing June's pattern. • USD CPI reached 125.61, up 3.12% year on year.

notes.FY26Q4: There was a slight increase in KYC Compliance due to the continuous reviewing and updating of customer KYC records. RBZ NPSD conducted an onsite DR inspection at Mutare Data Centre. Report is still outstanding. No new Statutory Instruments affecting the business were promulgated in the period under review
notes.FY27Q1: RBZ NPSD Onsite inspection conducted in May and the RBZ Financial Surveillance branch inspection for 3k outlets The 0.2% operational variance in liquidation score between Q4 and Q1 is transitory. To restore compliance by the next reporting cycle, we have requested immediate capacity reinforcement for the Merchant Operations function. On the 3rd of June 2026 the EcoCash corporate X account was compromised, and full access was gained within 6 hours. Preventive controls have been implemented, and investigations are still work in progress. Continued regulatory activities to ensure the business remain compliant and free from fines and corrective orders.
notes.FY27Q2: Three onsite inspections were completed in Q2: two by NPSD covering Prudential and AML, and one by the Financial Surveillance Department. No corrective orders, new statutory instruments affecting the business or regulatory fines were recorded. The Paida KYC audit and accuracy improvement exercise continues, supported by ongoing regulatory compliance activities.

notes.FY26Q4: Continuous expansion of channel partner distribution network. Improved customer experience. Customer substituting merchant payments with Cashout to enjoy lower transaction cost.
notes.FY27Q1: The EcoCash Super App was launched to offer customers an all in one comprehensive platform A Smartpay scheduler (split bills and payment reminders) was also launched
notes.FY27Q2: Lending (Kashagi) SME Wallet Remittances (Remittance Wallet) Global Payments - Seamless cross-border transactions and integration with international payment ecosystems Home Wallet - Diaspora customers to register and transact on EcoCash, without needing a Zimbabwean SIM. Enterprise Payments - B2B2C payments

notes.FY26Q4: 11 suspects were arrested in relation to OTP frauds. Training Campaigns are rolled out every quarter to enhance the human firewall. Phishing simulations are conducted every quarter to equip staff on how to spot and avoid online scams. Autonomous mode is enabled on Darktrace, enabling real-time, self-directed response.
notes.FY27Q1: The training campaign achieved a 99% completion rate. Additionally, an email restriction exercise was carried out. Quarterly phishing simulation exercises are conducted to equip staff with the skills to identify and avoid online scams. Autonomous mode is enabled on Darktrace, enabling real-time, self-directed response. There has been an increase in reported armed robbery cases targeting institutions like churches, school etc who are believed to keep cash on premise and EcoCash has implemented a zero over night cash holding policy.
notes.FY27Q2: OTP fraud incidents reached 792 in Q2 with a value of USD91.7K, reflecting continued social-engineering exposure. Awareness embedded in the OTP SMS. Collaboration with the courts and law enforcement agents. Customer awareness through digital, print and SMS. OTP SMS autofill for android users. Device binding will be implemented in Q3. Fraudulent SIM Swaps: 18 cases were recorded in FY27 Q2, resulting in losses of US$6.9K, compared to 17 cases and US$3K in Q1. The fraud involved unauthorized access to customer accounts following fraudulent SIM swaps. Four suspects have arrested. Cybersecurity awareness training achieved 97%; one quarterly phishing simulation was completed. Darktrace autonomous

notes.FY26Q4: There were no major system outages on EcoCash ancillary systems during Q4. On the 24 of January 2026, a core system change was successfully completed across EcoCash operations, marked by a full migration from the Comviva platform to Huawei platform. No Ecocash DR drill was conducted in Q4 due to system upgrade.
notes.FY27Q1: System stabilization following Ecocash upgrade with no exposures in April 2026 to date. Recoveries on going by finance at a recovery rate of 33% Technical issues on EcoCash were primarily due to third-party downtimes. In May 2026 we experienced a spike in Gateway Timeouts due to Core Network Instability
notes.FY27Q2: Q2 recorded 11 technical issues, mainly from third-party downtimes involving ZESA and DStv, USSD push-prompt timeouts and heat-related performance at the Mutare data centre. No system outages were recorded and uptime closed at 99.59%. Proactive monitoring enhancements were introduced. The EcoCash disaster recovery drill was completed on 9 August 2026, confirming operational readiness and framework effectiveness. Q2 revenue loss increased following Tariff undercharging issues and system downtimes.

notes.FY26Q4: DMT Partner training forums were conducted in December, January and February 1414 Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) were raised and forwarded to FIU for further investigation.
notes.FY27Q1: Majority of the suspicious transactions are characterized by multiple P2P transfers exceeding a predefined threshold, multiple unrelated senders with subsequent cash out immediately and a personal account receiving frequent payments from multiple customers or merchants consistent with business activity.
notes.FY27Q2: Q2 suspicious transaction reports increased to 1,891. Flagged activity included rapid cash-in/cash-out, suspicious P2P transfers indicating business activity on personal lines, suspected scam-victim transactions and IMTT structuring.

notes.FY26Q4: The business delivered a step-change in workforce stability, reducing attrition to 0.5% in Q4 while driving improved LAWES outcomes signalling the effectiveness of targeted engagement interventions in mitigating talent risk and strengthening organisational resilience.
notes.FY27Q1: Q1 attrition closed at 0.49%, significantly outperforming the <5% target indicating stability. Ongoing retention initiatives will be maintained.
notes.FY27Q2: Q2 attrition increased to 2.26%, remaining within the <5% target. Management will maintain targeted engagement and retention interventions to support sustainable workforce stability. LAWES remained at 4.2.

notes.FY26Q4: The drop in call answer and Social media response rate was triggered by the +400% traffic increase during the system upgrade phase. Customer satisfaction score was affected by the system upgrade. Refresher trainings were done in Q4 for the Omni team to ensure product knowledge is on point.
notes.FY27Q1: Improvement noted due to the ongoing resource optimisation exercise. System challenges experienced during the system changeover affected ratings. Customer responses post the system changeover challenges resolution boosted the ratings. Improvement noted due to the ongoing resource optimisation exercise. Refresher trainings to be done to ensure excellent product knowledge to reduce AHT.
notes.FY27Q2: A 66% increase in traffic reduced CAR to 31% and pushed average waiting time to 08:03; resource optimisation remains in progress. Social media response closed at 86% amid higher ChakaChaya launch enquiries. Customer satisfaction reached 87%, while weekly winner posts supported an NPS of 61. Continuous refresher training improved query resolution. Enroll more Ecocash use cases on Yamurai and increase market awareness on Yamurai usage to reduce traffic to call centre. USSD Self initiated P2P reversals and PIN resets awareness campaign to improve customer empowerment and reduce traffic to all touchpoints.

notes.FY26Q4: Comviva debt closed at US$ 294k due to payments towards the debt that were made during the period. Total debts increased due to Huawei equipment purchased by the business which was funded by MNO.
notes.FY27Q1: Conviva debt increased due to new invoices for the ingoing maintenance received in the current year. The maintenance work is part of the ongoing vendor transition
notes.FY27Q2: Comviva was paid in full. Other USD debt reduced to US$615k; intercompany creditors were ZWG189m, total creditors ZWG290m and debt older than 90 days reduced to ZWG8m.

notes.FY26Q4: The Business is continuously optimising the system, but we continue to see exposures whereby failed transactions are crediting customers on EcoCash However, following the system upgrade the exposures have been significantly reduced.
notes.FY27Q1: Notable improvement on revenue losses following improved system efficiency post cutover System stabilazation following Ecocash upgrade with no exposures in April 2026 to date. Recoveries on going by finance at a recovery rate of 33%
notes.FY27Q2: System stabilazation following Ecocash upgrade with no exposures from April 2026 to July and minor exposures in August.(USD7k) Recoveries for ZWG exposures are on going by finance at a recovery rate of 48% Recoveries for USD exposures are on going by finance at a recovery rate of 33%

notes.FY26Q4: The business has significantly grown the DMT network with partners currently sitting at over 13k active partners at the end of Q4. There has been significant improvements in the level of DMT Compliance in FY26. However, the is need for continuous investment to ensure that we minimise regulatory censure and possible penalties.
notes.FY27Q1: The business has significantly grown the DMT network with partners currently sitting at over 14k active partners at the end of Q1 The drop in DMT Compliance level is attributed to 1.5K new outlets that were onboarded and no licensing, inspection and training were done for them Work in progress to regularise
